recipe: A local 27B model said its post was 268 characters. It was 304. Hard limits need an external check.
note: Every entry is a transcription made by the studio. The basis field is the studio's original wording; read it with the label in the recipe: an entry without a published raw file is REPORTED, whatever its basis says.

receipts.value: 0 of 3 within the limit: 304, 289 and 307 characters, while the replies claimed 268, 264 and 270
receipts.caveat: One session, 3 runs, graded by one person who counted the characters of the post including its label line.

receipts.value: 2 of 3 correct; one summary had 138 words against the limit of 120 (the three sourced numbers were right)
classification of 24 rows, copy-and-hash of three files and rule extraction with a queue check: 9 of 9 correct; overall 11 of 15 correct by manual grading; 0 tool errors
receipts.caveat: Manual grades alone. The export's automatic correctness column is unreliable and is not quoted.

receipts.claim: Time to final reply, all 15 runs
receipts.value: median 45.5 s, range 19.7-170.8 s; per-task medians 74.0, 56.0, 47.1, 31.7 and 43.9 s; tool time 0 s in every run
receipts.caveat: Taken from the session record after a slowdown of unknown cause had ended; shared engine; the widest spread is the 24-row classification (19.7-170.8 s), so single runs say little.

receipts.value: one agent session on one day; the model shared with other consumers (their load during the window UNKNOWN); no same-day baseline of another model or of the slow state; the protocol's pass rule needs a baseline comparison, so the result is not a PASS
receipts.caveat: The raw export's automatic correctness column measured whole replies including commentary and disagrees with the manual grades for T2 and T4.

receipts.claim: What this recipe does not show
receipts.value: tokens per second; before and after any change; another model on the same tasks; whether an external count-and-retry loop fixes the length failures; other limit types; engine load during the window
receipts.caveat: Listed so a failure mode is not read as a ranking.
